events.description: Directional drilling with PDC bit 10 5/8" + PD + HTTA MWD + RHINO REAMER 12 1/4" from 5712m to 5719m (reaming to 5691m). Parameters: WOB 12-15 TON, 110-135 RPM, 14,000/16,500 FT-LB torque, 130 EPM, 500 GPM, 3900 PSI.

While drilling at 5717m, observed decrease in penetration rate of 9 min per meter. Subsequently drilled meter by meter from 5717m to 5719m, pulling string for safety. Controlled parameters: torque 17,000-19,000 FT-LB and WOB 5 TON.
Observed resistance to return to bottom from 5718.6 to 5719m with torque of 17,000-19,000 FT-LB.
Decided to pull string to 5690m to recover bottom sample and characterize with geology.
Pulled string and bit 10 5/8" from 5,719m to 5,692m to circulate well and recover bottom sample for geology characterization.

Directional drilling with PDC bit 10 5/8" + PD + HTTA MWD + RHINO REAMER 12 1/4" from 5,719m to 5,752m (reaming to 5,724m). Parameters: WOB 6-10 TON, 130 RPM, 14,000/16,500 FT-LB torque, 130 EPM, 500 GPM, 4000 PSI.
BIT RECORD: 352m in 166:00 hrs. RHINO: 318m in 144:44 hrs. Last 3 meters: 36' - 32' - 44'. Average: 32.78 min/m.
Increased mud density from 2.0 gr/cc to 2.02 gr/cc.
Pulled with circulation and without rotation to 5,712m to verify weights. Free. String weights: Static 206 TON, Up 222 TON, Off-bottom torque 13,500 FT-LB.
Suspended after obtaining 100 continuous drilling hours to make short trip according to program.
Observed loss of HTTA MWD signal at 5752m. Performed anti-jamming test, successfully recovering signal from tools (MWD).
Mud lost day: 0 m3. Stage accumulated: 527.4 m3. Gas units: 10.
